name: strays-desktop
description: The Electron overlay. Electron itself, and every command, live in the package at the repo root — this manifest exists so Electron knows which file to start.
//version: Deliberately absent. bin/strays.js starts Electron with this directory as the app, so app.getVersion() reads *this* file — and a version here is a second copy of a number only the root package.json ever bumps. It sat at 1.0.0 through four releases and told every npx user there was an update. See desktop/version.js.
